backbone.name: Polynormer-r
backbone.source_status: Use existing allowed backbone/operator runtime and boundary adapter; new dimension/role/trainer qualification still required. Do not reuse Amazon runner hardcoded24492nodes/5classes.

cost: Charge all source acquisition/field generation/fits/member forwards/selection/checkpoints/state+activation peak memory and serving. Independent banks pay four native models. No layer-state/cached-backbone reuse assumed after divergence.
data_source: Public WikiCS raw data.json via PyG2.7.0 WikiCS; raw/processed/split/features/support bytes and counts must be bound in a new acquisition/source packet. No dataset files read here.

decisions.TEST: Freeze all18 cell decisions first, then evaluate every selected seed/arm once on heldTEST without adaptation/reselection. No significance or graph-generalization claim from3optimization seeds on1split.
decisions.competence: Equal-seed mean member accuracy ofEG must not be lower thanE1; report minimum member and full member metrics too.
failures: Gain confined to one selected seed; mean paired gain nonpositive or member competence fails.
Strong single/independent controls dominate the claimed cost-quality operating point.
decisions.primary: Equal-seed pooled accuracy ofEG must exceed bothE1 andEI; preserve every seed.
decisions.strong_controls: CompareS,I1,IG complete-population quality and actual cost/storage. A capable single matching removes demonstrated ensemble utility. SimilarIG gain attributes ordinary graph-dependent bagging, leaving sharing only as measured tradeoff.

dropout: Separate route/member streams, paired across matching arms; do not force same realized dropout among members.
features: Use exact WikiCS loader x unchanged for all arms; no Amazon NormalizeFeatures, new concatenated graph fields or extra node features. PyG2.7 loader constructs raw FP32 features without another normalization transform.

field_generator.RMS: Normalize each field to TRAIN RMS1; if zero/nonfinite, stop without redraw.
field_generator.centering: Subtract TRAIN-mask mean independently for each of four raw comparison fields.
field_generator.graph_filter: F(P)=(I+P+P^2+P^3)/4; P=D^-1/2 A_prepared D^-1/2, no second selfloop addition
field_generator.graph_vs_iid_pair: graph raw fieldsF(P)xi_j, IID raw fieldsxi_j, same white draws
field_generator.one_common_bound: Divide all four normalized fields by max(1,max absolute over all four full-node fields). Thus all TRAIN RMS and full-node bounds match.
field_generator.statistical_note: Centering/scaling/balancing makes final IID-draw weights dependent; no literal independent-final-weights claim.
field_generator.white_distribution: seeded standard Gaussian over full public node axis; separate generator offset700001+base_seed, restore model/global RNG

gradient_identity: At identical member functions and shared Jacobians on common examples and same stochastic realization, mean w=1 implies ordinary shared gradient. No claim at distinct private initialization, independent dropout or later divergent functions. Deterministic preflight only.
loss: For each bank member, sum_v inTRAIN w_m(v)*CE(z_m(v),y_v)/N_TRAIN. Shared bank averages member losses; independent native models use their own ordinary weighted loss/Adam. No per-route sum-weight normalization or pooled-loss coefficient tuning.

roles.TEST: test_mask, closed through comparison/claim freeze; once per selected bank/seed afterward through separate held scorer.
roles.VALID: (val_mask | stopping_mask)[:,0] exactly as pinned author source

schedule.source_discrepancy: Paper Table5 warmup100/Epochs500 vs release local100+global1000. Fixed protocol deliberately selects released1100 for every arm; not an exact paper500-epoch reproduction.

selection.cadence: Every ordinary epoch for all arms; same100+1000 selection opportunities.
selection.global: Reset stage selector and choose first strict maximum complete pooled VALID accuracy over fixed global1000; this explicitly separates stages and persists flags.
selection.independent4: Synchronous bank snapshots/collective pooled selector, a declared joint-selection adaptation; no independent best-cycle recombination.
selection.local: First strict maximum complete pooled VALID accuracy; restore selected model and optimizer states at transition, retaining live end-local RNG.
selection.stored: Model, optimizer states and ownership, RNG/dropout states, stage flags, selected member and pooled metrics/checkpoint hashes.

serving: All members execute; uniform mean class probabilities as existing allowed Polynormer node-training source; singleton forS. Same pool for accuracy and NLL in every bank.
shared_init: Original source first-stem Rademacher/private output ones and copied biases. Identical acrossE1/EG/EI per seed. No silent warm or neutral initialization amendment.
shared_model: All dense weights learn; private stem/input/output factors and biases; each member performs its full local and global graph trajectory. No head-only common-latent bank.
split_replication_limit: Three optimization seeds on one fixed public split, not three independent graphs/splits.
status: Design only, no acquisition/implementation/training authorized by this note.
support: Explicit is_undirected=True; native to_undirected, remove selfloops, add one selfloop per node. Final edge count must be measured and bound; paper216123 edges are not asserted as final symmetrized+selfloop count.
